page.overview:
What is Battle of Crondre?

A diversionary battle was fought between the New Republic and the forces of Grand Admiral Thrawn during his military campaign. The assault on Crondre was used as a feint to draw New Republic forces away from Ord Pardron, which in turn left the planet Ukio vulnerable.
